# hiok_id_group_member (Resource)

A person or service principal in a HIOK ID group (and so holding the group's role).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The hiok_id_group's id.
- `member` (String) An email already invited with hiok_id_member, or a service principal's client_id.

### Optional

- `kind` (String) user (member is an email) or serviceprincipal (member is a client id).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
